    def __init__(self, rate, burst):
        if rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("rate must be > 0")
        if burst < 1:
            raise ValueError("burst must be >= 1")
        self.rate = rate
        self.burst = burst
        self._keys = {}  # key -> [tokens, last_now]

    def allow(self, key, now):
        if now < 0:
            raise ValueError("now must be non-negative")
        if key not in self._keys:
            # New key starts full
            self._keys[key] = [self.burst, now]
            # Consume one token
            self._keys[key][0] -= 1
            return True
        tokens, last_now = self._keys[key]
        # now going backwards for a key raises ValueError
        if now < last_now:
            raise ValueError("now going backwards for a key")
        # Refill tokens based on elapsed time
        elapsed = now - last_now
        added = elapsed * self.rate
        tokens = min(self.burst, tokens + added)
        self._keys[key][0] = tokens
        self._keys[key][1] = now
        if tokens >= 1:
            self._keys[key][0] = tokens - 1
            return True
        return False"}}}]
